_comment: Pinned identity of the R5 egress broker.
The broker is the security boundary for outbound traffic, so nothing
about it may float. The base image is the same pinned Hermes digest the
Developer image uses, which is what makes the upstream egress component
importable without adding a second supply chain.

volumes._comment_broker_home: The pinned base image declares VOLUME /opt/data. Naming it keeps every broker recreate from stranding another anonymous volume, and lets the trust-boundary check assert by name that the broker never receives the Developer's HERMES_HOME.
